---
applyTo: "**/*.py"

# Python practice guidance

Use this repo as a structured interview-prep workspace.

- Keep each file focused on one concept, pattern, or practice task.
- Prefer readable, explicit logic over compact or clever code.
- If a problem is interview-style, include the core idea in comments or a short docstring.
- Place examples in the appropriate roadmap phase folder.
- Validate with the smallest available Python command after edits.
